meridian-credits-release-1.0:
Meridian Credits release 1.0: Finance-approved initial credit agreement and CLI contract. Source: issue trial-5j0, "Quote a single renewal charge", description (2026-09-07). This record preserves the complete approved agreement, including multi-line rules beyond the single-line feature implemented in trial-5j0; those broader rules are approval, not a claim of implemented multi-line support.

Protocol and scope: Python standard-library local CLI, python3 main.py, accepts one JSON object on stdin and emits exactly one JSON object on stdout. No network, clock, locale, or third-party package is needed. Malformed input is outside these issues. Preserve {"command":"ping"} -> {"status":"ok","product":"Meridian Credits"} and existing unknown command response {"error":"unknown_command"}. JSON object key order is immaterial; response keys must be exactly those specified.

Data contract: Each charge line has exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id, service_on, charge_cents. IDs are nonempty strings, with line_id unique within a request. Subscription identity is the pair (account_id, subscription_id); a subscription_id can recur under different accounts and each subscription can have several charge lines. service_on is a valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD date from 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31 inclusive. charge_cents is a nonnegative integer in US cents. No line is excluded by service date. Each request is the complete charge set of one independently quoted monthly statement; caps apply within that set. Line collections may be empty. Lexicographic ID ordering means Unicode code-point order.

Approved release 1.0 calculation: Compute each line's uncapped credit as 10% of charge_cents, rounded down separately to integer cents. A 2400-cent credit cap is shared by every line with the same account_id across its subscriptions; distinct account groups have independent caps. Within each cap group, allocate credit by earliest service_on, then increasing line_id for equal dates. Each line receives its uncapped credit up to the remaining group cap; later lines receive the remainder or zero. Total credit is the sum of assigned line credits. Line amount due equals charge minus assigned credit; total due equals total charges minus total credit.

Version policy: Release "1.0" is the initial and currently selected agreement as introduced by trial-5j0. Omitting release selects the current agreement; explicit supported releases select that version. Introduced versions remain supported afterward. Public suites use explicit releases so their expectations survive current-agreement changes; run python3 test_public.py --cases PATH. No unsupported-release behavior was specified.

Single-line quote API introduced by trial-5j0: {"command":"quote","line":LINE}, optionally with "release":"1.0". Treat the line as the entire statement. Response contains exactly release ("1.0"), line_id copied from the input, credit_cents, and amount_due_cents. Example: charge 19999 -> credit 1999 and amount due 18000. Implementation verified with the supplied public_tests/release_1_quote.json suite and unittest checks covering ping, unknown commands, default/explicit release, zero/sub-cent rounding, the cap boundary, large integer charges, Unicode line IDs, and both allowed service-date endpoints.
